rr_tactical_justification: Primary pragmatic death-overs solution. Elite yorker execution, wide yorkers, and back-of-the-hand slower balls. Directly eliminates RR's 13.0+ ER death leakage (Sandeep 13.70, Deshpande 12.38 in 2026). Perfect tactical complement to Jofra Archer.
High-upside slingy death weapon (+3.39 raw lift in canonical baseline). Lethal dipping yorkers and sharp bouncers. Provides unique low release point contrasting Archer's high trajectory.

Generational death-overs bowling talent released by KKR following mid-season calf injury in 2026. Bowled 47.6% of deliveries at the death. Aggressive marquee bid target if bidding stays below INR 11.50 Cr.

Former RR spearhead. While powerplay bowling is fortified by Shami/Archer, Boult brings left-arm swing, franchise familiarity, and defensive experience. Strong fallback if death seamer prices escalate.
Left-arm off-cutter specialist with extensive IPL death bowling pedigree. Low-cost overseas death depth option if primary targets are bid up.
150+ km/h express pace enforcer. Provides raw middle-overs and death hit-the-deck pace depth behind Archer and Burger.

Premier released high-pressure boundary hitter (Model V4 Batter Rank 8, 55.5% Multiverse Top-10 consensus, +26.56 shrunk PWI). Exceptional boundary striker against pace at the death. Direct high-leverage hitting partner for Donovan Ferreira.
Veteran overseas clutch finisher with 487.6 HP balls faced (+18.93 shrunk PWI, 1000/1000 bootstrap draws). Proven IPL match-winner released by DC. Reliable middle/death batting insurance.

Pure domestic power hitter with proven boundary capabilities against extreme pace. Primary available domestic finisher after Shashank Singh and Naman Dhir were officially retained by PBKS and MI on 17 Nov 2026. Direct domestic hitting replacement for released Shimron Hetmyer.

Left-handed dynamic middle/lower-order enforcer. Key available domestic middle/death finisher following MI's retention of Naman Dhir. Strong boundary acceleration against spin in overs 11-16 and pace at the death.

Specialist high-impact Indian finisher (+29.7 raw lift in canonical model, 166.7 HP SR). Excluded from official Top-10 due to bootstrap resample instability (662 valid draws), but provides high upside in the auction.
Elite boundary fielder, dynamic lower-order finisher, backup wicketkeeper, and part-time off-spinner. Versatile overseas squad backup if RR seeks all-round flexibility.
Experienced Indian left-hand batter with positive pressure lift (+6.60). Adds middle-order stability and spin hitting in overs 7-15.
Former RR fast bowler with extensive experience (437.1 HP balls). Positive raw lift under pressure (+1.38). Provides crucial domestic pace insurance behind Mohammed Shami and Sandeep Sharma.
Former RR frontline pacer. V4 Bowler Rank 9 (+2.67 raw lift in canonical model). High release point and steep bounce. Reliable domestic pace depth if auction price stays reasonable.
Raw 150+ km/h domestic pace. Low-cost developmental pace backup at base price (INR 50L - 1 Cr).

Elite spin control profile (+2.75 shrunk impact in canonical model). However, following RR's pre-auction trade acquisition of M. Siddharth (LSG, 75L) alongside Ravindra Jadeja and Ravi Bishnoi, middle spin is numerically covered. Burning an overseas slot on spin is tactically subordinate to death seam and death hitting.
Economical domestic spinner (+2.41 raw lift in canonical model) and handy lower-order batter. Valuable domestic depth option if bid stays under INR 3.00 Cr.
